title: On complete morphisms of Butson Hadamard matrices
summary: A complete morphism of Butson classes replaces each entry of a matrix in $\mathrm{BH}(n,k)$ by an $m \times m$ block, uniformly, to produce a matrix in $\mathrm{BH}(mn,t)$. We show that every complete morphism is described by a pair $(U,Z)$, where $Z \in \mathrm{BH}(m,t)$ and $U$ is a unitary matrix annihilated by the $k^{\textrm{th}}$ cyclotomic polynomial. We deduce from a theorem of Lam and Leung that complete morphisms onto real Hadamard matrices exist precisely when $k$ is a power of $2$.
